newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread gains, Merrill remains positive.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread gains, Merrill remains positive.

text.p: Shares in brewer and leisure group Whitbread Plc gained 13 pence to 734 with broker Merrill Lynch repeating its positive stance on the stock ahead of first-half results due out on Tuesday, market makers said.
Whitbread, which is expected to report a profit rise of about 10 percent, earlier confirmed it was in talks to buy the pizza and pasta restaurant chains from BrightReasons.

"I don't think they are at all interested in the brands Bella Pasta and Pizzaland, but they might see it as a good route to secure sites across the country, in other words as a pure real estate deal," said Mark Puleikis, analyst at Merrill Lynch.
"I do not think they are worth more than 300,000 stg a site and really Whitbread should see it as a way of gaining sites for their other brands like Costa Coffee or Cafe Rouge," he added.
